name: booking-policy
title: Booking policy
description: A shop's booking terms as pure functions: the deposit and the balance after a gift card, the free cancellation period and who gets a refund, when a late cancellation uses up a gift card, how long an unpaid booking holds its time, when a payment checkout expires, and the allowed booking lengths.

facilities.description: Deposit and balance, free cancellation and refunds, gift card use on late cancellation, payment holds, checkout expiry and booking lengths

text.purpose: The rules a shop applies around a booking, kept apart from the booking flow so the booking page shows the same numbers the server charges. A booking pays a deposit online (`depositPercent` of the total, less any gift card) and the balance at the appointment. A customer who cancels more than `freeCancellationHours` before the start gets the deposit back; the owner's cancellation is always free; a late cancellation by the customer keeps the deposit and uses up a gift card. A booking waiting for payment holds its time and its gift card for `holdMinutes`, a payment checkout expires after `checkoutMinutes`, and a booking lasts from `minimumMinutes` to `maximumMinutes`.
text.userInputs: `depositPercent` (0 takes no deposit and confirms at once, 100 takes the whole price online), `freeCancellationHours`, `holdMinutes` (at least `checkoutMinutes`), `checkoutMinutes` (31 to 1440: the payment provider accepts 30 minutes to 24 hours), `minimumMinutes` and `maximumMinutes` for the length of one booking. The defaults are the source shop's terms.
text.integration: Pure functions on the web and the server (`web/index.ts`, `server/index.ts`). The booking page calls `depositAndBalance` to show what is paid now; the reservations component calls the same functions with the same settings when it creates the checkout (`checkoutExpiry`), counts the bookings that hold a gift card (`holdActive`), previews a cancellation (`refundEligible`, `freeCancellationDeadline`) and cancels (`refundEligible` for the deposit, `cardConsumedByCancellation` for the gift card). Amounts are integers in minor units.
text.infrastructure: No service, account or stored data.
text.verification: `tests/web.test.ts` checks the settings template and its limits, the deposit and balance against the source's own `giftCardAmounts` run on 18 cases, other percentages, the strict deadline (exactly the free period before the start is late), owner and customer cancellations with and without a deposit, a card-only booking keeping its card when cancelled early, the hold boundary, the checkout expiry in whole seconds with the provider's limits, durations, and the example. The class suite (`classes/booking-policy-class/check.mjs`) checks the same contract against any implementation.
text.scenarios: Example Studio books a Relaxing Massage and a Deep Facial (15500) paid partly with a 6000 gift card: the customer pays a 1750 deposit online and 7750 at the studio. Cancelling two days ahead refunds the deposit and keeps the card; cancelling the evening before keeps the deposit and uses up the card. A shop that takes no deposits sets `depositPercent` to 0.
text.updates: Patch updates replace the files only; the component keeps no data. Changing a setting changes the terms of new bookings only if the application stores what it charged.

agentInstructions: Select this component for the booking-policy slot of any shop that takes bookings. Set `depositPercent` and `freeCancellationHours` from the recipe's answers; leave `holdMinutes` and `checkoutMinutes` at their defaults unless the payment provider changes its checkout limits; set `minimumMinutes` and `maximumMinutes` to the shortest and longest booking the shop's catalogue allows. Connect the provided `booking-policy` to the reservations component.
developerInstructions: Nothing to supply. Show the cancellation terms on the booking page from the same settings: the deadline is `freeCancellationDeadline(startsAt, settings.freeCancellationHours)`. Keep `holdMinutes` at least `checkoutMinutes` (the settings refuse less), so a checkout that is still open never loses its time or gift card.

suitability.notes: Pure functions. The checkout expiry limits (30 minutes to 24 hours) are Stripe's, from https://docs.stripe.com/api/checkout/sessions/create (expires_at).

infrastructure.deployedReason: No deployed service: functions in the application.
